title: 理事長代理との出会い

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day during training, I encounter a woman I've never met before. She rather harshly berates me for being too lax in my training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then calmly proceeds to criticize the academy for overvaluing its students' independence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gesturing to a lush forest in the distance, she asserts that athletes, just like forests, must be carefully managed in order to thrive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only then do I learn that this harsh critic is none other than Riko Kashimoto, our new temporary director.
